query:
UPDATE customers
            SET billing_address_id = (
                    SELECT other.id
                    FROM customer_contexts other
                    WHERE other.customer_id = customers.id
                      AND other.deleted_at IS NULL
                      AND other.kind = 'BILLING'
                    ORDER BY other.created_at ASC
                    LIMIT 1
                ),
                updated_at = $2
            WHERE billing_address_id = $1
